name: ART-1
summary:
ART-1 is the second-generation large humanoid in ARTROBOT's development programme. The company's historical account identifies it as a platform used in public demonstrations, including the Chinese television programme Ji Zhi Guo Ren. It belongs to a broader research effort on bipedal humanoid movement and control.

This record represents that historical ART-1 generation. Capabilities and hardware specifications of later ART robots should not be assumed to apply to it without a matching model-specific source.
